Northern Sotho: Magareng ga dingwalwa tše 90 tšeo di feleleditšego di lekodišišwa, 65 (88%) e beile šedi go phethagatšo ya tshekatsheko/alkorithime goba ditlhathollo tše di beakantšwego gabotse, ka bohlatse bja maemo a godimo bja kakanyo ya malwetši a a HIV ao a sepelelanago le mengwaga ye e nepagetšego le bong bjo kgaogantšwego maemong a bosetšhaba le a selete go ditikologo tša badudi ka kakaretšo, eupša e sego go magato a tikologo a makaone go bea pele thibelo.
Amharic: በመጨረሻ ከተገመገሙት 90 ሰነዶች መካከል፣ 65 (88%) በምርመራ/የአልጎሪዝም አፈጻጸም ወይም ዘዴያዊ መግለጫዎች፣ ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው በብሔራዊ ወይም በክልል ደረጃዎች አጠቃላይ የሰዎች መቼት ላይ በእድሜ- እና በጾታ-ያልተከፋፈለ የኤችአይቪ ክስተት ግምት ላይ ያተኩራሉ፣ ነገር ግን ለጥቃቅን ጂኦግራፊያዊ ደረጃዎች ለመከላከል ቅድሚያ ለመስጠት አይሆኑም።

English: The remaining 25 documents described field-derived incidence (n=14) and non-incidence (n=11) use cases, including integrating RITAs into routine surveillance and assisting with molecular genetic analyses, but evidence was generally weaker or only reported on what was done, without validation data or findings related to effectiveness of recency assays when used for these purposes.
Luganda: Ebiwandiiko ebisigadde 25 byannyonnyola abapya abafuna obulwadde (n=14) n’omuwendo ogutamanyirwa ku bapya abafuna obulwadde (n=11), omuli n’okukozesa enkola za RITAs mu kulondoolanga n’okuyambako n’okwekenneenya endagabutonde, naye obukakafu okutwaliza awamu bwali bunafu oba bwalagibwanga ku ekyo ekyakolebwa, awatali bubaka bukakasa oba ebizuuliddwa ebyekuusa ku butuukirivu bw’enkebera z’obupya nga zikozeseddwa olw’ebigendererwa bino.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwé 25 yòókù ṣàpèjúwé àwọn ìṣẹ̀lè tí wọ́n rí ní oko-ìwádìí (n=14) àti àwọn àìṣẹlẹ̀ (n=11) bí ìlò ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀, èyí tún ṣe àkóónú mímú RITAs wọ ìlànà ìṣọ̀fíntótó tí ó ti di bárakú àti ṣíṣe ìrànwọ́ pẹ̀lú ìtúpalẹ̀ molékù ajẹmọ́ ẹ̀yọ́-ìran, àmọ́ ẹ̀rí náà lápapọ̀ mẹ́hẹ tàbí kí ó jẹ́ wí pé ohun tí wọ́n se nìkan ni wọ́n jábọ̀, láìsí ìfẹsẹ̀dátàmúlẹ̀ tàbí àwọn àbọ̀ àyẹ̀wò àkóónú àti ìpéye àìpẹ́ tí ó múnádóko ní tí wọ́n bá lò ó fún ìdí náà.
Zulu: Imibhalo engama-25 esele ichaze izehlakalo ezisuselwa kunkambu (n=14) nezingezona ezehlakalo (n=11) zokusetshenziswa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganisa ama-RITA ekugadweni okujwayelekile nokusiza ngokuhlaziywa kofuzo kwamangqamuzana, kodwa ubufakazi ngokuvamile babubuthakathaka noma bubikwa kuphela ngalokho okwenziwayo., idatha engagunyaziwe noma okutholiwe okuhlobene nokusebenza kokuhlolwa kwakamuva uma kusetshenziselwa lezi zinhloso.
Hausa: Sauran takardun guda 25 da aka kwatanta abubuwan da suka samo asali daga fage (n=14) da faruwa ba na gangan ba (n=11) suna amfani da lokuta, gami RITAs da aka haɗa a cikin sa-ido na yau da kullum da kuma taimakawa tare da nazarin ƙwayoyin gado, amma shaida gabaɗaya ta yi rauni ko kuma an bayar da rahoton abin da aka yi kawai, ba tare da ingantattun bayanai ko sakamako da suke da alaƙa da tasiri na gwajin baya-bayan nan a lokacin da aka yi amfani domin waɗannan dalilai.
Northern Sotho: Dingwalwa tše dingwe tše di šaletšego tše 25 tše di hlalošitšwego phatlalalo ye e theilwego godimo ga tikologo (n=14) le tšhomišo ya malwetši ao e sego a phatlalalo (n=11), go akaretša kgokaganyo ya di-RITA ka go kgoboketšo ya tshedimošo ya nako le nako le go thuša ka ditshekatsheko tša ditlhamegotšini tša dimolekhule, eupša bohlatse e be e le bjo bokoa ka kakaretšo goba ke fela bjo bo begilwego go seo se dirilwego, ntle le datha ya tiišetšo goba dikutollo tše di amanago le go šoma ka tshwanelo ga ditshekatsheko tša bjalebjale ge di šomišetšwa merero ye.
Amharic: ቀሪዎቹ 25 ሰነዶች ከመስክ የተገኘ ክስተት (n=14) እና ያልተከሰተ (n=11) የአጠቃቀም ጉዳዮችን፣ አርአይቲኤስን ከመደበኛ ክትትል ጋር በማዋሃድ እና በሞለኪውላር የዘረመል ትንታኔዎች መርዳትን ጨምሮ ገልጸዋል፣ ነገር ግን ማስረጃው በአጠቃላይ ደካማ ነበር ወይም በተደረገው ነገር ላይ ብቻ ተዘግቧል፣ ለእነዚህ ዓላማዎች ጥቅም ላይ በሚውልበት ጊዜ ከቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎች ውጤታማነት ጋር የማረጋገጫ መረጃ ወይም የተዛመዱ ግኝቶች ሳይኖሩ ተከናውኗል።

English: HIV recency assays have been widely validated for estimating HIV incidence in age- and sex-specific populations at national and sub-national regional levels; however, there was a lack of evidence validating the accuracy and effectiveness of using recency assays for nonincidence surveillance use cases.
Luganda: Enkebera z’obupya bwa HIV zikakasiddwa wangi mu kugeraageranya omuwendo gw’abantu abafuna HIV mu bantu ab’emyaka n’ekikula ekimu ku mutendera gw’eggwanga n’ebitundu; wabula, tewabaddeewo bukakafu ku butuukirivu bw’okukozesa enkebera z’obupya mu kuzuula abalwadde abalina akawuka akatali kapya.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò àkóónú àti ìpéye àìpẹ́ HIV ti di ìtẹ́wọ́gbà lọ́pọ̀lọ́pọ̀ ibi fún ìṣòdiwọ̀n ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ HIV àti iye òǹkà ènìyàn ṣakọṣabo ní pàtó ní ìpele orílẹ̀-èdè àti ẹ̀ka agbègbè; àmọ́ ṣá, kò sí ẹ̀rí tí ó fi ẹsẹ̀ ìgbàwọlé náà múlẹ̀ àti ìmúnádóko lílo àyẹ̀wò àkóónú àti ìpéye àìpẹ́ fún ìṣọ̀fíntótó àìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìlò.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV kuye kwaqinisekiswa kabanzi ukuze kulinganiswe iminyaka yobudala kanye nenani labantu eliqondene nobulili obuthile emazingeni esifunda kazwelonke nangaphansi kwezwe; nokho-ke, kube nokushoda kobufakazi obuqinisekisa ukunemba nokusebenza kahle kokusetshenziswa kokuhlolwa kwakamuva emacaleni okusetshenziswa kokugada okungezona ezehlakalo.
Hausa: An tabbatar da gwajin baya-bayan nan na HIV da yawa domin ƙiyasta hoon faruwar cutar HIV da ƙayyadaddun jinsi a matakan yanki na ƙasa da ƙananan yanki na ƙasa; duk da haka, akwai ƙarancin shaidar da take tabbatar da daidaito da ingancin yin amfani da gwajin baya-bayan nan na al’amuran amfani na sa-ido ba na gangan ba.
Northern Sotho: Ditshekatsheko tša bjalebjale tša HIV di tiišeditšwe ka bophara go akanya dipalopalo tša phatlalalo ya malwetši a HIV a go fetela ka thobalano maemong a bosetšhaba le a dilete tše di bopago karolo ya naga; le ge go le bjalo, go bile le tlhokego ya bohlatse ya go tiišetša nepagalo le go šoma ka tshwanelo ga tšhomišo ya ditshekatsheko tša bjalebjale go kgoboketšo ya tshedimošo ye e sa amanego le malwetši.
Amharic: በብሔራዊ እና በንዑስ-ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ ደረጃዎች የዕድሜ እና ጾታ-ተኮር ህዝቦች ላይ የኤችአይቪን ክስተት ለመገመት የኤችአይቪ ቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎች በሰፊው ተረጋግጠዋል፤ ሆኖም፣ ያልተከሰተ የክትትል አጠቃቀም ጉዳዮች ቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎች የመጠቀም ትክክለኛነት እና ውጤታማነት የሚያረጋግጥ ማስረጃ እጥረት ነበር።

English: The evidence identified through this review will be used in forthcoming technical guidance on the use of HIV recency assays for surveillance use cases by WHO and UNAIDS; further evidence on methodologies and effectiveness of non-incidence use cases is needed.
Luganda: Obukakafu obuzuuliddwa mu kwetegereza kuno bujja kukozesebwa mu kuwabula okw’ekikugu eri WHO ne UNAIDS ku kukozesa enkebera z’obupya bwa HIV mu kulondoola omuwendo gw’abalwadde; obukakafu obulala bwetaagisa ku nkola n’obutuukirivu bw’okukozesa enkola ezitali za kuzuula omuwendo gw’abapya abafuna obulwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀rí tí wọ́n tọ́ka sí láti ara àgbéyẹ̀wò yìí ni wọn yóò ṣàmúlò nínú ìtọ́sọ́nà ajẹmọ́ ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ lórí ìlò àyẹ̀wò àkóónú àti ìpéye àìpẹ́ HIV fún bí WHO àti UNAIDS ṣe ḿa lò ó fún Ìṣọ̀fíntótó; a nílò ̀erí síwájú sí i nípa ọgbọ́n ìwádìí àti ìmúnádóko ìlò àìṣẹlẹ̀.
Zulu: Ubufakazi obuhlonzwe ngalokhu kubuyekezwa buzosetshenziswa ekuqondisweni kwezobuchwepheshe okuzayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kokuhlolwa kwe-HIV kwamacala okusetshenziswa okugadwa yi-WHO kanye ne-UNAIDS; ubufakazi obengeziwe mayelana nezindlela kanye nokusebenza kahle kwamacala okusetshenziswa okungezona ezehlakalo kuyadingeka.
Hausa: Shaidar da aka gano ta wannan bita za a yi amfani da ita a cikin jagorar fasaha mai zuwa game da yin amfani da gwajin baya-bayan nan na cutar HIV domin al’amuran sa-ido kan amfani daga WHO da kuma UNAIDS; ana buƙatar ƙarin shaida a kan hanyoyin da tasirin al’amura da ba na gangan ba.
Northern Sotho: Bohlatse bjo bo hlaotšwego ka tsela ya tekodišišo ye di tla šomiša go tlhahlo ya sethekniki ye e latelago ka go tšhomišo ya HIV ditshekatsheko tša bjalebjale ya tšhomišo ya tshedimošo ye e kgobokeditšwego ke WHO le UNAIDS; bohlatse bjo bongwe go mekgwa le go šoma ka tshwanelo ga tšhomišo ya malwetši a go se phatlalale e a hlokega.
Amharic: በዚህ ግምገማ የተገኘው ማስረጃ በWHO እና በUNAIDS ለክትትል አጠቃቀም ጉዳዮች የኤችአይቪ ቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎች አጠቃቀም ጉዳዮችን በሚመለከት ቴክኒካል መመሪያ ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል፤ ያልተከሰተ የአጠቃቀም ጉዳዮች ዘዴዎች እና ውጤታማነት ላይ ተጨማሪ ማስረጃ ያስፈልጋል።

English: A test that indicates how recently a patient was infected with HIV is known as a “recency” test.
Luganda: Enkebera eraga ddi omuntu lwe yafuna HIV emanyiddwa nga enkeber “y’obupya”.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò tí ó ṣàfihàn bí ó se ti pẹ́ sí sígbà tí aláìsàn ní ìkóràn HIV ní a mọ̀ sí “àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́”.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa okubonisa ukuthi isiguli sisanda kutheleleka kanjani nge-HIV kwaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlola “okusanda kwenzeka”.
Hausa: Gwajin da yake nuna yadda a baya-bayan nan majiyyaci ya kamu da cutar HIV an san shi da suna gwajin “baya-bayan nan”.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tšeo di laetšago ka moo molwetši go lemogilwego gabjale gore o feteditšwe ke HIV ye e tsebegago bjalo ka diteko tša “bjalebjale”.
Amharic: አንድ ታካሚ ምን ያህል በቅርብ ጊዜ በኤችአይቪ እንደተያዘ የሚያመለክት ምርመራ "የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ" ሙከራ በመባል ይታወቃል።

English: Researchers who looked at how the global healthcare sector uses these tests said that besides tracking actual infections, the tests may be useful for HIV prevention planning and estimating new cases in larger populations.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abaatunuulira engeri ekiseera ky’ebyobulamu gye kikozesa enkebera zino kwagamba nti ng’oggyeeko okulaga obulwadde bwennyini, enkebera zino ziyinza okuyamba mu nteekateeka z’okulwanyisa HIV n’okugeraageranya abantu abapya abafuna akawuka mu bantu abangi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n wò bí ẹ̀ka ìṣètò ìlera àgbáyé ṣe ń ṣàmúlò àwọn àyẹ̀wò wọ̀nyí sọ pé yàtọ̀ títọpasẹ̀, àwọn àyẹ̀wò wọ̀nyí lè wúlò fún ìsètò ìsénàmọ́ HIV àti ṣíṣe òdiwọ̀n àwọn iye ìṣẹ̀lè tuntun ní ibi tí àwọn ènìyàn pọ̀ sí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi ababheke ukuthi umkhakha wezokunakekelwa kwempilo emhlabeni wonke usebenzisa kanjani lezi zivivinyo bathi ngaphandle kokulandelela izifo zangempela, ukuhlolwa kungase kube usizo ekuhleleni ukuvimbela i-HIV kanye nokulinganisa amacala amasha kubantu abaningi.
Hausa: Masu binciken da suka kalli yadda ɓangaren kiwon lafiya na duniya yake amfani da waɗannan gwaje-gwajen sun ce baya ga bin diddigin ainihin kamuwa da cutar, gwaje-gwajen sana iya zama da amfani ga tsare-tsare na rigakafin cutar HIV da kuma ƙiyasta sababbin masu kamuwa da cutar a cikin mutane masu yawa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši bao ba lebeletšego ka moo lekala la tlhokomelo ya tša maphelo le šomišago diteko tše ba boletšego gore ntle le go lota mohlala wa diphetetšo tša makgonthe, diteko di ka ba bohlokwa go tšhomišo ya peakanyo ya thibelo ya HIV le go akanya malwetši a maswa go ditšhaba tše kgolo.
Amharic: የአለም ጤና አጠባበቅ ዘርፍ እነዚህን ምርመራዎች እንዴት እንደሚጠቀም የተመለከቱ ተመራማሪዎች ትክክለኛ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ከመከታተል በተጨማሪ፣ ምርመራዎቹ ለኤችአይቪ መከላከያ እቅድ ማውጣት እና በትላልቅ ህዝቦች ውስጥ አዳዲስ ጉዳዮችን ለመገመት ጠቃሚ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ብለዋል።

English: The researchers have therefore called for more widespread use of recency tests to monitor the spread and control of HIV.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza noolwekyo baateesa wabeewo okukozesa ennyo enkebera z’obupya okusobola okulondoola ensaasaana n’ennwanyisa ya HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ti wá torí èyí pè fún ìlò àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ tó gbòòrò síi láti bójútó ìtànká àti ìdarí HIV.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke abacwaningi bacele ukusetshenziswa kabanzi kokuhlolwa kwakamuva ukuze kuqashwe ukusabalala nokulawulwa kwe-HIV.
Hausa: Domin haka, masu binciken sun yi kira da a ƙara yin amfani da gwaje-gwaje na baya-bayan nan domin sa-ido a kan yaɗuwar cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ka gona ba ipileditše gore go be le tšhomišo ye e phatlaletšego kudu ya diteko tša bjalebjale go lekodišiša phatlalalo le taolo ya HIV.
Amharic: ስለሆነም ተመራማሪዎቹ የኤችአይቪን ስርጭትን እና ቁጥጥርን ለመከታተል የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎችን በስፋት መጠቀም እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል።

English: In general, recency tests or ‘recency assays’ can be used to test for many things.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, enkebera z’obupya zisobola okukozesebwa okukebera ebintu bingi.
Yoruba: Lápapọ̀, àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ tàbí ‘àyẹ̀wò àkóónú àti ìpéye àìpẹ́’ lè ṣe é lò láti ṣàyẹ̀wò ọ̀pọ̀ nǹkan.
Zulu: Ngokuvamile, ukuhlolwa kwakamuva noma 'izivivinyo zamuva' kungasetshenziswa ukuhlola izinto eziningi.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, ana iya amfani da gwaje-gwajen baya-bayan nan ko kuma ‘gwajin baya-bayan nan’ dominn gwada abubuwa da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, diteko tša bjalebjale goba ‘ditshekatsheko tša bjalebjale’ di ka šomišwa go lekola go dilo tše ntši.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ፣ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች ወይም 'የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎች' ብዙ ነገሮችን ለመፈተሽ ጥቅም ላይ ሊውሉ ይችላሉ።

English: It might be used for following up on how someone might have got infected (contact tracing), or for identifying areas with high infections.
Luganda: Esobola okukozesebwa okulondoola engeri omuntu gye yafunamu akawuka, oba okuzuula ebitundu ebirimu abalwadde abangi.
Yoruba: Ó lè jẹ́ lílo láti se àtilẹ́yìn bí ẹnìkan ṣe ní ìkóràn (ìfikanra wá), tàbí láti fi tọ́ka àwọn agbègbè tí ìkóràn wọn pọ̀.
Zulu: Ingase isetshenziselwe ukulandelela ukuthi umuntu kungenzeka ukuthi utheleleke kanjani (ukulandelela ukuthintana naye), noma ukuhlonza izindawo ezinezifo eziphezulu.
Hausa: Ana iya amfani da shi don bin diddigin yadda wani zai iya kamuwa da cutar (binciken tuntuɓar mutum), ko domin gano wuraren da suka fi ɗauke da cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: E ka šomišetšwa go lota mohlala mabapi le ka moo motho yo mongwe a ka fetetšwago ka gona (go latišiša mesepelo), goba go lemoga mafelo ao a nago le diphetetšo tša godimo.
Amharic: አንድ ሰው እንዴት በኢንፌክሽኑ እንደተያዘ ለመከታተል (የንክኪ ፍለጋ)፣ ወይም ከፍተኛ ኢንፌክሽን ያለባቸውን ቦታዎች ለመለየት ጥቅም ላይ ሊውል ይችላል።

English: But these tests have not been scientifically verified for such purposes.
Luganda: Naye enkebera zino tezinnaba kukakasibwa kinnassaayansi okukola emirimu gino.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ wọn kò ti fi òǹtẹ̀ ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì tẹ̀ ìlò àwọn àyẹ̀wò wọ̀nyí fún ìdí yìí.
Zulu: Kodwa lokhu kuhlola akuzange kuqinisekiswe ngokwesayensi ngezinjongo ezinjalo.
Hausa: Amma ba a tabbatar da waɗannan gwaje-gwajen ta hanyar kimiyya ba domin irin waɗannan dalilai.
Northern Sotho: Eupša dipoelo tše ga se tša netefatšwa ka tsela ya saentshe go merero yeo.
Amharic: ነገር ግን እነዚህ ሙከራዎች ለእንደዚህ አይነት ዓላማዎች በሳይንሳዊ መንገድ አልተረጋገጡም።

English: In this work, researchers reviewed how HIV recency tests are being used globally, as a step towards verifying their use for disease monitoring.
Luganda: Mu mulimu guno, abanoonyereza beetegereza engeri enkebera z’obupya bwa HIV gye zikozesebwamu okwetooloola ensi, okugezaako okukasa enkozesa yaazo mu kulondoola obulwadde.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ yìí, àwọn aṣewádìí ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò bí wọ́n ṣe ń lo àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ HIV kárí ayé, gẹhgẹ́ bí ìgbésẹ̀ láti rí àrídájú ìlò fún ìṣòfúntótó àrùn.
Zulu: Kulo msebenzi, abacwaningi babuyekeze ukuthi ukuhlola kwakamuva kwe-HIV kusetshenziswa kanjani emhlabeni wonke, njengesinyathelo sokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwazo ukuqapha izifo.
Hausa: A wannan aikin, masu binciken sun sake nazarin yadda ake amfani da gwaje-gwajen baya-bayan nan na cutar HIV a duniya, a matsayin wani mataki na tabbatar da amfani da su domin sa-ido da cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Ka mošomong wo, banyakišiši ba lekodišitše ka moo diteko tša bjalebjale tša HIV di šomišwago lefaseng ka bophara, bjalo ka kgato ya go tiišetša tšhomišo ya tšona ya lekodišišo ya bolwetši.
Amharic: በዚህ ሥራ፣ ተመራማሪዎች እንደ አንድ እርምጃ ለበሽታ ክትትል መጥቀማቸውን ለማረጋገጥ፣ የኤችአይቪ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እንዴት ጥቅም ላይ እንደሚውሉ ገምግመዋል።

English: They interviewed people working with the World Health Organisation (WHO) and the United Nations (UN) about the use of recency tests in HIV testing programmes.
Luganda: Baabuuza abantu abakola n’Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi Yonna (World Health Organisation (WHO)) n’Omukago gw’Amawanga Amagatte (United Nations (UN)) ku nkozesa y’enkebera z’obupya mu nteekateeka z’okukebera HIV.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi ọ̀rọl wá àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń bá àjọ tí ó nh rih sí ètò ìlera àgbáyé (WHO) àti àjọ ìṣọ̀kan àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè (UN) lẹ́nu wò nípa ìlò àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ nínú àwọn ètò àyẹlwò HIV.
Zulu: Baxoxisane nabantu abasebenza neWorld Health Organisation (WHO) kanye ne-United Nations (UN) mayelana nokusetshenziswa kokuhlolwa kwakamuva ezinhlelweni zokuhlolelwa i-HIV.
Hausa: Sun tattauna da mutanen da suke aiki tare da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) da Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya (UN) game da amfani da gwaje-gwaje na baya-bayan nan a cikin shirye-shiryen gwajin cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ba botšišitše batho bao ba šomago le World Health Organisation (WHO) le United Nations (UN) mabapi le tšhomišo ya diteko tša bjalebjale ka mananeong a go dira diteko a HIV.
Amharic: ከዓለም ጤና ድርጅት (WHO) እና ከተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት (ተመድ) ጋር አብረው የሚሰሩ ሰዎችን በኤችአይቪ መመርመሪያ መርሃ ግብሮች ውስጥ ስለ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች አጠቃቀም ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

English: The WHO and UN are big institutions that oversee health issues around the world.
Luganda: WHO ne UN bitongole binene ebirondoola ensonga z’ebyobulamu mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: WHO àti UN jẹ́ àjọ ńlá tí ó ń sí ọ̀rọ̀ ìlera kárí ayé.
Zulu: I-WHO kanye ne-UN yizikhungo ezinkulu ezengamele izindaba zezempilo emhlabeni jikelele.
Hausa: WHO da UN manyan cibiyoyi ne da suke kula da lamuran lafiya a faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: WHO le UN ke mekgatlo ye megolo yeo e ukametšego merero ya maphelo go kgabaganya le lefase.
Amharic: WHO እና ተመድ በዓለም ዙሪያ የጤና ጉዳዮችን የሚቆጣጠሩ ትልልቅ ተቋማት ናቸው።

English: They also searched for available documents on the topic, published between 2010 and 2021.
Luganda: Era baanoonya ebiwandiiko ebiriwo ku nsonga eno, ebyafulumizibwa wakati wa 2010 ne 2021.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún wá àwọn ìwé tí ó wà lórí kókó-ọ̀rọ̀ náà, tí wọ́n tẹ̀ jáde láàrin 2010 sí 2021.
Zulu: Baphinde basesha amadokhumenti atholakalayo ngesihloko, ashicilelwe phakathi kuka-2010 no-2021.
Hausa: Sun kuma nemo wasu wanzazzun takardu a kan batun, wanda aka buga a tsakanin shekarun 2010 da kuma 2021.
Northern Sotho: Ba nyakane le dingwalwa tše di lego gona mabapi le dihlogopoledišano, tše di gatišitšwego magareng ga 2010 le 2021.
Amharic: በ2010 እና 2021 መካከል የታተሙ፣ በርዕሰ ጉዳዩ ላይ ያሉትን ሰነዶችም ፈልገዋል።

English: They found 90 relevant documents.
Luganda: Baazuula ebiwandiiko 90 ebikwata ku nsonga eno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí àwọn ìwé 90 tí ó ṣe kókó.
Zulu: Bathole imibhalo engu-90 efanele.
Hausa: Sun sami takardu guda 90 da suka dace.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše dingwalwa tša maleba tše 90.
Amharic: 90 ተዛማጅ ሰነዶችን አግኝተዋል።

English: If these, 65 used recency tests to check for new HIV infections.
Luganda: Ku bino, 65 byakozesa enkebera z’obupya okuzuula abalwadde ba HIV abapya.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí, 65 ni ó lo àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ láti ṣàyẹ̀wò ìkóràn HIV tuntun.
Zulu: Kulaba, abangama-65 basebenzise ukuhlolwa kwakamuva ukuze bahlole ukutheleleka okusha kwe-HIV.
Hausa: Daga cikin waɗannan, guda 65 sun yi amfani da gwaje-gwaje na baya-bayan nan domin bincika sababbin cututtukan HIV.
Northern Sotho: Go tšona, tše 65 di šomišitše diteko tša bjalebjale go lekola diphetetšo tše mpsha tša HIV.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ውስጥ፣ 65ቱ አዲስ የኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ለመፈተሽ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎችን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: The researchers said that among the 65 studies that had used recency tests to estimate new cases, some did that in large national surveys, while others used them to estimate new cases in large and high risk populations.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ku kunoonyereza okw’emirundi 65 okwakozesa enkebera z’obupya okuteebereza abalwadde abapya, okumu kwazikozesa mu kunoonyereza kw’eggwanga okunene, so ng’abalala baazikozesa okugeraageranya abalwadde abapya mu bibinja by’abantu abangi era abali mu bulabe obungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé láàrin àwọn ìwádìí 65 tí wọ́n ti ṣàmúlò àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ láti se òdiwọ̀n ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun, àwọn mìíràn ṣe é ní ààyè tí ó fẹjú, nígbà tí àwọn yòókù lò wọ́n láti se òdiwọ̀n àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun ní ibi tí àwọn ènìyàn pọ̀ sí tí ó sì léwu.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi phakathi kwezifundo ezingama-65 ebezisebenzise izivivinyo zakamuva ukulinganisa amacala amasha, abanye bakwenzile lokho ocwaningweni olukhulu lukazwelonke, kanti abanye balusebenzise ukulinganisa amacala amasha kubantu abakhulu nabasengozini enkulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce a cikin binciken guda 65 da suka yi amfani da gwaje-gwaje na bayan-bayan nan don ƙiyasta sababbin kamuwa, wasu sun yi hakan ne a cikin babban binciken ƙasa, a yayin da wasu suka yi amfani da su don ƙiyasta sababbin kamuwa a cikin yawan jama’a masu babban haɗarin kamuwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore magareng ga dinyakišišo tše 65 tšeo go šomišitšwego diteko tša bjalebjale, tše dingwe tša tšona di dirile ka diphatišišo tša bosetšhaba tše kgolo, mola tše dingwe di šomišitše go akanya malwetši a maswa go ditšhaba tše kgolo le tšeo di lego kotsing ye kgolo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አዳዲስ ጉዳዮችን ለመገመት የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎችን ከተጠቀሙባቸው 65 ጥናቶች መካከል፣ አንዳንዶቹ በትልልቅ ሀገር አቀፍ የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች ውስጥ የተደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎቹ ደግሞ በትልቅ እና ከፍተኛ ተጋላጭነት ባለው ህዝብ ውስጥ አዳዲስ ጉዳዮችን ለመገመት ተጠቅመዋል ብለዋል።

English: The researchers said the 65 studies provided strong evidence, because they had shown that the recency tests were very effective.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okunoonyereza kwa mirundi 65 kwawa obukakafu obw’amaanyi, kubanga baalaga nti enkebera z’obupya zaali zikola bulungi nnyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé ìwádìí 65 fi ẹ̀rí tí ó nípọn lélẹ̀, torí wọ́n ti fi hàn pé àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ múnádóko gan-an.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi izifundo ezingu-65 zinikeze ubufakazi obuqinile, ngoba babonise ukuthi izivivinyo zakamuva ziphumelele kakhulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce bincike guda 65 sun bayar da ƙwaƙƙwarar shaida, saboda sun nuna cewa gwaje-gwajen na baya-bayan nan sun yi tasiri sosai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tše 65 di fane ka bohlatse bjo maatla, ka baka la gore di laeditše gore ke diteko tša bjalebjale di šoma ka tshwanelo kudu.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ 65ቱ ጥናቶች ጠንካራ ማስረጃዎችን አቅርበዋል፣ ምክንያቱም የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራዎች በጣም ውጤታማ መሆናቸውን አሳይተዋል ብለዋል።

English: The researchers said the other 25 studies used the test for general HIV monitoring purposes.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okunoonyereza okulala okw’emirundi 25 kwakozesa enkebera eno olw’okulondoola HIV okw’awamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn ìwádìí 25 mìíràn lo àyẹlwò náà fún ìmójútó HIV lápapọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ezinye izifundo ezingama-25 zasebenzisa ukuhlolwa ngezinjongo ezijwayelekile zokuqapha i-HIV.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sauran binciken guda 25 sun yi amfani da gwajin domin dalilan sa-ido a kan cutar HIV bakiɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tše 25 di šomišitše diteko go merero ya tekodišišo ya HIV ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሌሎቹ 25 ጥናቶች ምርመራውን ለአጠቃላይ የኤችአይቪ ክትትል ዓላማዎች ይጠቀሙበታል ብለዋል።

English: Evidence from these studies was generally weak because those studies only reported on what was done, but did not validate findings related to effectiveness of recency tests when used for these purposes.
Luganda: Obukakafu obuva mu kunoonyereza kuno bwali bunafu okutwaliza awamu kubanga okunoonyereza okwo kwalaga ekyo kyokka ekyakolebwa, naye tekwakakasa byazuulibwa ebyekuusa ku butuukirivu bw’enkebera z’obupya nga zikozeseddwa olw’ebigendererwa bino ebirala.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀rí láti inú àwọn ìwádìí yìí lẹ lápapọ̀ torí àwọn ìwádìí wọ̀nyí kàn jábọ̀ lórí ohun tí ó ẹ́ ṣíṣe ni, wọn kò fìdí àbọ̀ ìwádìí nípa ìmúnádóko àìpẹ́ nígbà tí wọ́n bá lò ó fún èyí múlẹ̀.
Zulu: Ubufakazi obuvela kulezi zifundo ngokuvamile babubuthakathaka ngoba lezo zifundo zibike kuphela ngalokho okwenzekile, kodwa akuzange kuqinisekise okutholakele okuhlobene nempumelelo yokuhlolwa kwakamuva lapho kusetshenziselwa lezi zinhloso.
Hausa: Shaida daga waɗannan binciken gabaɗaya ta kasance mai rauni saboda waɗannan binciken kawai sun bayar da rahoton abin da aka yi ne, amma ba su tabbatar da sakamakon binciken da ya danganci tasirin gwaje-gwajen baya-bayan nan da aka yi ba lokacin da aka yi amfani domin waɗannan dalilai.
Northern Sotho: Bohlatse go tšwa dinyakišišong tše di be di le bokoa ka kakaretšo ka gore dinyakišišo tšeo di begile fela ka seo se dirilwego, eupša ga se tša tiišeletša dikutollo tše di amanago le go šoma ka tshwanelo ga diteko tša bjalebjale ge di šomišetšwa merero yeo.
Amharic: የእነዚህ ጥናቶች ማስረጃዎች በአጠቃላይ ደካማ ነበሩ ምክንያቱም እነዚያ ጥናቶች የተከናወኑትን ብቻ ዘግበዋል፣ ነገር ግን ለእነዚህ ዓላማዎች ጥቅም ላይ ሲውሉ ከቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች ውጤታማነት ጋር የተያያዙ ግኝቶችን አላረጋገጡም።

English: The researchers further said, out of the 25 studies, 16 (64%) used what they got from recency tests to estimate new HIV infections in the larger general population.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti, ku kunoonyereza kuno okw’emirundi 25, 16 (64%) kwakozesa ebyafunibwa mu nkebera z’obupya okugeraageranya abalwadde ba HIV abapya mu bantu bonna awamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún sọ síwájú síi pé nínú ìwádìí 25, 16 (64%) lo ohun tí wọ́n ri nínú àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ láti se òdiwọ̀n àwọn ìkóràn HIV tuntun nínú iye ènìyàn tí ó túbọ̀ fẹjú lápapọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqhube ngokuthi, ezifundweni ezingama-25, abayi-16 (64%) basebenzise abakuthola ekuhlolweni kwakamuva ukuze balinganisele ukutheleleka okusha kwe-HIV kubantu abaningi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ci gaba da cewa, daga cikin bincike guda 25, guda 16 (64%) sun yi amfani da abin da suka samu daga gwaje-gwajen na baya-bayan nan da aka yi domin ƙiyasta sababbin cututtukan HIV a cikin yawan jama'a.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše le gore, godimo ga dinyakišišo tše 25, 16 (64%) di šomišitše tšeo ba di hweditšego go tšwa go diteko tša bjalebjale go akanya diphetetšo tše mpsha tša HIV go bakgathatema ba bantši ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪም ከ25 ጥናቶች ውስጥ፣ 16 (64%) ከቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች ያገኙትን ተጠቅመው በሰፊው ህዝብ ውስጥ አዲስ የኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ለመገመት ተጠቅመዋል ብለዋል።

English: While the other 9 used recency test results for other analysis, for example, to do molecular genetic analyses.
Luganda: So ng’okulala okw’emirundi 9 kwakozesa ebyava mu nkebera y’obupya mu kwekenneenya okulala, okugeza, okukola okwekenneenya kw’endagabutonde.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí èsì àwọn àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ 9 di ohun tí wọ́n lò fún àwọn ìtúpalẹ̀ mìíràn, bí àpẹẹrẹ, láti ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmẹ́yọ-ìran onímólékù.
Zulu: Ngenkathi ezinye eziyisi-9 zasebenzisa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamuva kokunye ukuhlaziya, isibonelo, ukwenza ukuhlaziya kofuzo lwamangqamuzana.
Hausa: A yayin da sauran guda 9 suka yi amfani da sakamakon gwajin domin wani bincike, alal misali, don yin nazarin ƙwayoyin gado.
Northern Sotho: Mola e le gore tše dingwe tše 9 di šomišitše dipoelo tša diteko tša bjalebjale go tshekatsheko ye nngwe, mohlala, go dira ditshekatsheko tša ditlhamegotšini tša molekhule.
Amharic: ሌሎቹ 9ኙ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች ውጤቶችን ለሌላ ትንታኔ፣ ለምሳሌ፣ ሞለኪውላር የዘረመል ትንታኔዎችን ለመስራት ተጠቅመዋል።

English: In molecular genetic analysis, scientists used genetic molecules like DNA to study differences that could put some individuals at more risk than others.
Luganda: Mu kwekenneenya kw’endagabutonde, bannassaayansi baakozesa endagabutonde okwetegereza enjawukana eziyinza okuleetera abantu abamu okubeera mu bulabe okusinga ku balala.
Yoruba: Nínú ìtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmẹ́yọ-ìran onímólékù, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì lo molékù ajẹmẹ́yọ-ìran bíi DNA láti wádìí àwọn ìyàtọ̀ tí ó lè fi àwọn ẹ̀dá kọ̀ọ̀kn sínú tí ó ju ti àwọn yòókù lọ.
Zulu: Ekuhlaziyeni izakhi zofuzo zamangqamuzana, ososayensi basebenzisa amangqamuzana ofuzo njenge-DNA ukuze bahlole umehluko ongabeka abantu abathile engozini kakhulu kunabanye.
Hausa: A cikin nazarin ƙwayoyin gado, masana kimiyya sun yi amfani da ƙwayoyin gado kamar ƙwayar halittar DNA domin nazarin bambance-bambancen da za su iya sanya wasu mutane cikin haɗari fiye da wasu.
Northern Sotho: Go tshekatsheko ya ditlhamegotšini tša dimolekhule, ditsebi tša mahlale di šomišitše ditlhamegotšini tša dimolekhule tše bjalo ka DNA go ithuta dipharologantšho tšeo di ka beago batho ba bangwe mo kotsing ye kgolo go feta ba bangwe.
Amharic: በሞለኪውላዊ የዘረመል ትንታኔ ውስጥ፣ ሳይንቲስቶች አንዳንድ ግለሰቦችን ከሌሎች የበለጠ አደጋ ላይ ሊጥሉ የሚችሉ ልዩነቶችን ለማጥናት እንደ ዲኤንኤ ያሉ የዘረመል ሞለኪውሎችን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: The researchers said they found 2 studies that used genetic information to study how different sexual behaviours affected spread of HIV.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti baasanga okunoonyereza kwa mirundi 2 okwakozesa obubaka bw’endagabutonde okwetegereza engeri enneeyisa ey’enjawulo mu byokwegatta gy’ekosaamu ensaasaana ya HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn rí ìwádìí 2 tí ó lò àlàyé ajẹmọ́ ẹ̀yọ́ ìran láti ṣe ìwádìí lórí bí onírúnrú ìwà ajẹmọ́-ìbálòpọ̀ ṣe ń nípa lórí ìtànká HIV.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi bathole ucwaningo olu-2 olwasebenzisa ulwazi lolibofuzo ukuze kucwaningwe ukuthi ukuziphatha okuhlukene kocansi kuthinta kanjani ukusabalala kwe-HIV.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sun sami bincike guda 2 da suka yi amfani da bayanan ƙwayoyin gado domin nazarin yadda ɗabi’un jima'i daban-daban suke shafar yaɗuwar cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ba hweditše dinyakišišo tše 2 tšeo di šomišitšego tshedimošo ya ditlhamegotšini go ithuta ka moo maitshwaro a tša thobalano a go fapafapana ao a amilego go phatlalala ga HIV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የተለያዩ ጾታዊ ባህሪያት የኤችአይቪ ስርጭት ላይ እንዴት ተጸዕኖ እንደሚያሳድሩ ለማጥናት የዘረመል መረጃን የተጠቀሙ 2 ጥናቶችን ማግኘታቸውን ተናግረዋል።

English: They also said among those 25, they found some researchers who used recency tests to report on new HIV cases in routine HIV programmes, and others who informed targeted prevention planning in another long-term study.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti mu abo 25, baasangamu abanoonyereza abamu abaakozesa enkebera z’obupya okwogera ku balwadde ba HIV abapya mu pulogulaamu za HIV ez’ebiseera ebigere, n’abalala abaayogera ku nteekateeka eziziyiza mu kunoonyereza okw’ekiseera ekiwanvu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé láàrin àwọn 25 náà, wọ́n rí àwọn aṣèwádìí kọ̀ọ̀kan tí wọ́n ṣàmúlò àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ láti ṣẹ̀sùn àwọn ìṣẹ̀lè HIV tuntun nínú àwọn ìlànà-bárakú ètò HIV, àti àwọn mìíràn tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀sùn àlàyé ètò ìdáàbòbò nínú ìwádìí ọlọ́jọ́pípẹ́ mìíràn.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi phakathi kwalabo abangu-25, bathole abanye abacwaningi abasebenzisa izivivinyo zamuva ukuze babike ngezigameko ezintsha ze-HIV ezinhlelweni ezijwayelekile ze-HIV, nabanye abazisa ukuhlelwa kokuvikela okuhlosiwe kolunye ucwaningo lwesikhathi eside.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun ce a cikin waɗancan guda 25, sun sami wasu masu bincike da suka yi amfani da gwaje-gwaje na baya-bayan nan domin bayar da rahoto game da sababbin masu kamuwa da cutar HIV a cikin shirye-shiryen cutar HIV na yau da kullum, da kuma wasu waɗanda suka sanar da tsare-tsaren rigakafin da aka yi niyya a wani binciken na dogon lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le gore magareng ga bao ba 25, ba hweditše banyakišiši ba bangwe bao ba šomišitšego diteko tša bjalebjale mabapi le ka moo diteko tša HIV go mananeo a routine a HIV, le ba bangwe bao ba lemogilego peakanyo ya thibelo ye e nepilwego go dinyakišišo tše dingwe tša paka ye telele.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ከ25ቱ መካከል፣ አንዳንድ ተመራማሪዎች በመደበኛ የኤችአይቪ ፕሮግራሞች ውስጥ አዳዲስ የኤችአይቪ ጉዳዮችን ሪፖርት ለማድረግ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎችን ያደረጉ እና፣ ሌሎች ደግሞ በሌላ ለረጅም-ጊዜ ጥናት የታለመ የመከላከል እቅድን ያሳወቁ ተመራማሪዎችን አግኝተናል ብለዋል።

English: Finally, the researchers said the use of recency tests for other purposes might increase now that the government of the United States of America had started a programme that funds poor countries with HIV, and it required that recency tests be done together with the usual HIV tests.
Luganda: Ekisembayo, abanoonyereza baagamba nti okukozesa enkebera z’obupya olw’ebigendererwa ebirala kiyinza okweyongera olw’okuba nti kati gavumenti ya America yali etandise pulogulaamu y’okuwa ssente amawanga amaavu agalimu HIV, nga yali eyagala enkebera z’obupya zikolebwe awamu n’enkebera za HIV eza bulijjo.
Yoruba: Nígbẹ̀yìn, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé ìlò àyẹlwò àìpẹ́ fún àwọn nǹkan mìíràn lè pọ̀ sí ní báyìí tí ìjọba ilẹ̀ United States of America ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ètò kan tí ó ń kówó lé àwọn ìlú tí kò lówó tí wọ́n ní HIV, ó sì gba pé àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́ di síṣe lápapọ̀ mọ́ àyẹ̀wò HIV tí a ti mọ̀.
Zulu: Ekugcineni, abacwaningi bathi ukusetshenziswa kokuhlolwa kwamuva kwezinye izinhloso kungase kwande njengoba uhulumeni wase-United States of America usuqale uhlelo oluxhasa amazwe ampofu ane-HIV, futhi udinga ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwakamuva kwenziwe kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-HIV okujwayelekile.
Hausa: A ƙarshe masu binciken sun ce yin amfani da gwaje-gwaje na baya-bayan nan domin wasu dalilai yana iya ƙaruwa a yanzu bayan da gwamnatin Amurka ta fara wani shiri na tallafawa ƙasashe matalauta masu ɗauke da cutar HIV, kuma ta buƙaci a yi gwaje-gwajen baya-bayan nan tare da gwaje-gwajen HIV da aka saba yi.
Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, banyakišiši ba boletše gore tšhomišo ya diteko tša bjalebjale go merero ye mengwe e ka oketšega ka ge e le gore mmušo wa United States of America o thomišitše ka lenaneo leo le thekgago ka ditšhelete dinaga tše di diilago ka HIV, le gona e be e nyaka gore diteko tša bjalebjale di dirwe mmogo le diteko tše dingwe tša tlwaelo tša HIV.
Amharic: በመጨረሻም፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ አሜሪካ መንግስት በኤችአይቪ የተያዙ ደሃ ሀገራትን የሚደግፍ ፕሮግራም በጀመረበት በአሁኑ ወቅት የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎችን ለሌላ ዓላማዎች መጠቀሙ ሊጨምር እንደሚችል፣ እና የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች ከተለመደው የኤችአይቪ ምርመራ ጋር እንዲደረጉ ይጠይቃል ብለዋል።

English: They cautioned that some of the recency tests they reviewed were no longer used because of their poor performance.
Luganda: Baalabula nti ezimu ku nkebera z’obupya ze beetegereza zaali tezikyakozesebwa olw’obutakola bulungi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n pẹ̀ fún ìjánu pé àwọn kọ̀ọ̀kan lára àwọn àyẹ̀wò àìpẹ́  tí wọ́n se àgbéyẹ̀wò ni wọn kò lò mọ́ torí ìṣe wọn tí kò kájú ìwọ̀n.
Zulu: Baxwayise ngokuthi ezinye izivivinyo zakamuva abazibuyekeza azisasetshenziswa ngenxa yokungenzi kahle kwazo.
Hausa: Sun yi gargaɗin cewa ba a yi amfani da wasu daga cikin gwaje-gwajen baya-bayan nan da suka yi bita ba saboda rashin ƙarfin aikinsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemošitše gore tše dingwe tša diteko tša bjalebjale tšeo ba di lekodišitšego di be di sa hlwe di šomišwa ka baka la phethagatšo ya tšona ye e sa kgotsofatšego.
Amharic: አንዳንድ የገመገሟቸው የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ ሙከራዎች በደካማ አፈጻጸማቸው ምክንያት ከአሁን በኋላ ጥቅም ላይ እንዳልዋሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።

English: The researchers also said some other relevant documents were not included in this review as they were only found after the review had been completed.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti ebimu ku biwandiiko ebirala eby’omugaso tebyassibwa mu kwetegereza kuno kubanga byafunibwa ng’okunoonyereza kuwedde.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún sọ pé àwọn ìwé mìíràn tí wọ́n tún ṣe kókó tí wọn kò fi sínú àgbéyẹ̀wò yìí tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ rí lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti parí àgbéyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathi eminye imibhalo efanele ayizange ifakwe kulokhu kubuyekezwa njengoba itholakale kuphela ngemva kokuphothulwa kokubuyekezwa.
